title: Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 tsp chicken spice mix or salt
instructions: Mix it up in a bowl, slather some on top of pork ribs, and wrap them in tin foil.
Bake at 150C for about two hours, then check for doneness.
Once tender, uncover, add the juice to the remainder of the spice mix, and brush on top.
Finish baking at higher temp so it crusts up nicely.
Once done, use the juices as a dip base (+ add spices similar to rub)
Serve with new dip, jalapenos, pickles, mustard, bread, etc.
